messages:
Maya Chen: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
- Did: validated prewarm script for eu-west1 T4 pools, fixed small bug in rwdctl that dropped spot pools during rotate.
- Blockers: still seeing sporadic quota errors in az-a for p-qa tenants (400/quota). Opened cloud support but need temporary workaround.
- Today: will sweep queued jobs, trigger targeted prewarm, and leave notes for handoff. @Jonah can you confirm fallback policy for eu-west1 if spot capacity drops? :coffee:

Jonah Lee: Yep — we fallback to reserve-tier and then to lower-memory model. I filed INC-4321 with cloud for az-a limits. Temporary command to reserve capacity:```bash
rwdctl capacity reserve --region=eu-west1 --count=4 --priority=reserve
```Use that until cloud confirms. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Noticed a 2% eviction spike on KV cache around 03:40 UTC which might explain a few tail latency blips. I'll pull the metric and post a small graph in a minute. If evictions stay >1% we should consider increasing cache replicas for eu-west1. :eyes:

Sam Ortiz: Canaries are running in us-west2 with the new batching config (batch_size cap + adaptive delay). No errors so far, throughput +8% in initial run. Will monitor error rate; if >0.5% rollback to current config. No blockers from my side.

infra-bot: [ops] capacity-plan: added 4 reserved GPUs in ap-southeast1 for customer commit; plan link: https://console.redwood/ops/plan/987. Autoscaler note: eu-west1 scale-up cooldown 6m.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. @Priya post the KV chart here when ready and @Sam I’ll add your canary results to the rollout doc. Leaving handoff notes: I’ll be on pager rotation after 18:00 UTC, reachable on Slack. If cloud support responds, please tag me in INC-4321. :rocket:
